name: Name (optional)
location_help: Leave the name blank to generate one. The engine chooses the checkout directory.
branch_help: Leave blank for the engine’s naming policy. An existing free local branch keeps its current tip.
parent_help: The parent controls sidebar nesting. The Git source and base branch choose the starting code.
agent_help: Agent: None. After creation, you can choose an agent, model and first message. Engine setup tabs are preserved.
created_help: The worktree is ready. Starting an agent is optional and uses this existing checkout.
legacy: This engine supports basic branch and path creation. Advanced options require an updated Orca adapter.
pending: Creation is still in progress. You can close this dialog and check the same request later.
parent_mismatch: Choose a parent on this computer and engine, or choose no parent.
unsupported: This engine does not support a selected option. Review the choices before creating.
base_missing: The selected base is no longer available. Choose a listed branch.
storage_failed: Could not save this creation request in the browser. Free browser storage and retry.
recovery_failed: Could not restore the previous request safely. Keep this browser session and review its result before creating again.
not_ready: Wait for repository options before creating.
offline: This computer is offline. Reconnect it before creating.
use_basic: Use basic branch and path mode
basic_help: Basic mode uses branch and path creation with the source workspace’s default placement. Clear unsupported choices to continue.
update_composer: Update Orca before using the advanced worktree composer
